name: ai-playground Development Rules
description: Rules for AI agents developing on the ai-playground monorepo

spockTestIndentation.description: Enforce proper Spock test indentation in *Spec.groovy files
spockTestIndentation.rule: Block labels (given:, when:, then:, expect:, where:) must be at method indentation level. Code within blocks must be indented 4 additional spaces.
spockTestIndentation.example:
def "test name"() {
    given:
        setup = value
    when:
        result = action()
    then:
        result == expected
}

indentationStyle.description: Enforce consistent indentation across file types

buildVerification.description: Always verify builds pass before committing

gitCommitFormat.description: Enforce semantic commit messages with session URL
gitCommitFormat.example:
feat(M1.S2): add Spring Boot application entry point

https://claude.ai/code/session_01167MP14uz3Yhbkz2ctW64m

branchNaming.description: Enforce branch naming convention for AI agents

taskStatusUpdates.description: Update story status when completing tasks
taskStatusUpdates.rule: Change story status from '[ ]' to '[x]' and add '> **Status:** ✅ Done' line after story title

editorConfigCompliance.rule: All code changes must comply with .editorconfig rules for their respective file types

rules: Never force-push without explicit user authorization
Never skip git hooks with --no-verify or similar flags
Never use 'mvn' directly in restricted networks—use build helper instead
Never batch unrelated changes in a single commit
Never omit session URL from commit messages
Never mark a task complete if tests don't pass
